title: Compile experimental data and matrix elements
action: From the instruction's embedded tables (containing experimental transition moments, state dipole moments, Herman–Wallis factors, and weights for CO, HCl, and DCl) and the harmonic-oscillator matrix elements ⟨v|q^k|v'⟩, construct the design matrix A and weight vector for the weighted linear least-squares determination of the dipole expansion coefficients p0–p3. Assemble rows for each experimental observable using the linear model expressions relating observables to p_k and the provided matrix elements.
description: Data assembly step; no output file is required.

title: Weighted least-squares fit of dipole expansion coefficients
action: Perform a weighted linear least-squares fit using the assembled design matrix and weight vector to determine the coefficients p0, p1, p2, p3 in the expansion M(q) = p0 + p1 q + p2 q^2 + p3 q^3 for CO and for HCl (using both HCl and DCl data jointly for the HCl isotopologue set). Output the fitted coefficients as a JSON file.
description: Fitted dipole expansion coefficients p0–p3 for CO and HCl in Debye.
output_schema: JSON object with top-level keys 'CO' and 'HCl'. Each key holds an object with numeric keys 'p0', 'p1', 'p2', 'p3' (floats in Debye). Example shape: {"CO": {"p0": 0.1243, "p1": -0.1465, "p2": 0.000434, "p3": 0.000237}, "HCl": {"p0": 1.0930, "p1": 0.1018, "p2": 0.00039, "p3": -0.00096}}
